title: Geoapify OpenAPI catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of Geoapify OpenAPI specifications and their canonical documentation pages. Load only the specifications needed for an integration.

apis.title: Geoapify Batch API
apis.description: The Batch requests let to pack multiple API requests into one API call. As a result, pay up to 50% less for geospatial operations. Cache/store results with no limits.

apis.title: Geoapify Boundaries API
apis.description: The Boundaries API lets to query administrative, political, low-emission areas boundaries. Moreover, you can get the list of subdivisions and boundaries hierarchy.

apis.title: Geoapify Elevation API
apis.description: The Elevation API returns elevation data for given locations. Provide coordinates and get elevation values in meters or feet.

apis.title: Geoapify Address Autocomplete API
apis.description: The documentation contains Address Autocomplete API reference and code samples. Learn more about Address Autocomplete API inputs and data structure.

apis.title: Geoapify Batch Geocoding API
apis.description: Batch Geocoding API lets you geocode addresses in bulk. You’ll get addresses with latitude, longitude, and output fields. Check our code samples and use cases you might be interested in.

apis.title: Geoapify Forward Geocoding API
apis.description: Forward Geocoding converts text addresses into lat-long coordinates. Search addresses, cities, postcodes (or zipcodes), call the API with Javascript, Java, Python, and other languages.

apis.title: Geoapify Reverse Geocoding API
apis.description: The documentation contains Reverse Geocoding API reference and code samples. Learn more about Geocoding API input parameters and result object.

apis.title: Geoapify Geometry Operations API
apis.description: Perform spatial analysis and geometry operations on GeoJSON data. Calculate unions, intersections, buffers, distances, lengths, areas, clustering, and more with 42 supported operations.

apis.title: Geoapify Geometry API
apis.description: The API calculates unions and intersections of complex geometries generated by Geoapify APIs. For example, union or intersections of isolines.

apis.title: Geoapify Map Marker API
apis.description: Marker Icon API to create beautiful icons for your maps with Material Design and Font Awesome. Choose a size, style, colors, add text or icon as content.

apis.title: Geoapify IP Geolocation API
apis.description: Get location by IP address to learn more about visitors

apis.title: Geoapify Isoline API
apis.description: The Isolines API calculates isochrones and isodistances for a location. An isoline shows how far you can get from the place and area reachable within a specific time or distance.

apis.title: Geoapify Map Matching API
apis.description: Map Matching API snaps given geographical coordinates (GPX) to the existing road network. The API also allows you to choose a desired travel mode for cars, trucks, pedestrians, etc.

apis.title: Geoapify Map Tiles API
apis.description: Here is a list of Map Tiles URLs for OpenStreetMap maps. Check our code samples of using ZYX-tile server and style.json links to create a tile layer.

apis.title: Geoapify Static Maps API
apis.description: Learn how to create Static Maps or map pictures in PNG or JPG format with API. Various OSM-map styles and beautiful Map Markers. Use CSS or HTML to add a map.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Routing: Calculate Route
apis.description: Calculate routes between geographic waypoints with the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Routing: Calculate Route Matrix
apis.description: Calculate travel times and distances between source and target locations with the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Utilities: Combine Geometries
apis.description: Intersect, subtract, merge, or calculate an envelope around GeoJSON geometries with the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Utilities: Evaluate Spatial Relation
apis.description: Evaluate containment, intersection, validity, and other spatial predicates with the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Geocoding: Geocode Address
apis.description: Geocode a free-form address with the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Geocoding: Geocode Structured Address
apis.description: Geocode structured address components with the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Places: List Place Categories
apis.description: List the supported category values for the Geoapify MCP search_places tool.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP API
apis.description: Use Geoapify location tools from MCP-compatible clients with JSON-RPC requests.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Utilities: Measure Geometry
apis.description: Measure areas, lengths, distances, and bounds for GeoJSON geometries with the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Geocoding: Reverse Geocode Coordinates
apis.description: Reverse geocode latitude and longitude coordinates with the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Places: Search Places
apis.description: Find places and points of interest by category near geographic coordinates with the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

apis.title: Geoapify MCP Tool: Utilities: Transform Geometry
apis.description: Buffer, simplify, rotate, scale, translate, or calculate centers for GeoJSON geometries with the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

apis.title: Geoapify Place Details API
apis.description: The Place Details API lets you get detailed information about a place or location, including contact details, area and building geometry, surroundings.

apis.title: Geoapify Place Info API
apis.description: Retrieve categorized place information for coordinates or an OpenStreetMap object.

apis.title: Geoapify Places API
apis.description: The Places API helps to query places, amenities, and points of interest using more than 400 categories. We use the OpenStreetMap as the data source. Cache/store results with no limits.

apis.title: Geoapify Postcode API
apis.description: Get location by IP address to learn more about visitors

apis.title: Geoapify Route Matrix API
apis.description: Route Matrix API to calculate the time-distance matrix between multiple points

apis.title: Geoapify Route Planner API
apis.description: Route Planner API to calculate delivery route and manage agents

apis.title: Geoapify Routing API
apis.description: A Routing API  to calculate route and directions for vehicles of many types, including cars, trucks, buses, bicycles, pedestrians, and hikers.
